topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: When I heard the news, the place where we shared so many plates, laughter, and quiet moments is no more, a deep silence echoed where the clatter of dishes and chatter of friends used to fill the air. I think of the way the light used to fall through the windows, casting shadows that danced on the walls as we talked about everything and nothing. It's hard to imagine the space empty, stripped of the warmth that we helped to create. But memories, like the flavors of our favorite meals, linger long after the last bite. I am glad for the times we had, and I hold onto them, letting them fill me as I would with a last, cherished taste.
